parameters.name: Prompt
parameters.description:
The input description for the AI task.

- When the task type is Generate Template, this parameter specifies the functionality of the template to be generated.
- When the task type is FixTemplate, this parameter can describe how the template should be repaired.

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description:
The type of AI task. Values:
- GenerateTemplate: AI template generation
- FixTemplate: AI template repair

parameters.name: Template
parameters.description: When the task type is AI template repair, specify the original template that needs to be fixed or modified.

parameters.name: TemplateType
parameters.description: The type of the template to be generated or repaired. Default is ROS.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros create-ai-task --task-type GenerateTemplate --prompt Create_oneECS,_and_deploynignx_service --template ROSTemplateFormatVersion_:_2015-09-01 --template-type ROS --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ros CreateAITask --region cn-hangzhou --TaskType GenerateTemplate --Prompt 'Create_oneECS,_and_deploynignx_service' --TemplateType ROS --Template 'ROSTemplateFormatVersion_:_2015-09-01'
